text:
josh_se: Heads-up: Nimbus' security team asked for a compact SIEM/audit artifact for their vendor review. POC in two days. They want: sample admin events, forwarding options (Splunk HEC/syslog/S3), retention defaults, and whether we support customer KMS and object lock.

anya_sec: Short answer we can send today. Mapping notes: admin/audit -> CAIQ/CCM audit controls; forwarding/streaming -> SIG monitoring; retention/immutability -> CAIQ retention.

josh_se: Can you paste two tiny example events (single-line JSON) and one-line forwarder snippet? Keep it email-friendly.

anya_sec: Sure. Admin action example:
{"event_type":"admin_action","ts":"2025-11-15T14:02:05Z","actor":"u_321","action":"change_role","target":"user_99","req":"req_901"}

Detection example:
{"event_type":"detection","ts":"2025-11-15T14:05:10Z","name":"admin_login_bruteforce","sev":"high","count":42}

anya_sec: Minimal forwarder (curl -> Splunk HEC):
curl -k https://splunk-hec.example.com:8088/services/collector -H "Authorization: Splunk <token>" -d @/var/log/redwood/audit.log

anya_sec: Retention defaults (hosted): API logs 90d hot/13mo cold; Admin/audit 1y default, option to archive up to 7y to customer S3 with Object Lock in GOVERNANCE mode; Auth events 13mo; inference metrics 90d. For Dedicated/Private we defer to customer infra and can point directly to their SIEM/S3.

josh_se: Add a one-liner about encryption and RBAC we can paste into the procurement response.

anya_sec: "All logs encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Customers may provide a KMS key for S3 archival. Access to audit logs is role-restricted (SOC, org_admin) and access is itself logged."

ops-bot: POC instance for nimbus scheduled at 2025-11-17T03:00:00Z.

josh_se: Great — I'll send this with a one-page mapping to SIG/CAIQ and attach the two examples. If they ask for network allowlist, I'll follow up with egress IP ranges and mutual TLS options.

anya_sec: If they want an immutable SLA, mark it as an add-on for Dedicated/Private and loop legal.

josh_se: Will do. Sending now.
